extraction_notes: The SS24F column is covered by the SS22F-SS24F grouped values in the electrical characteristics table: VF maximum 0.55 V at IF = 2.0 A, IR1 maximum 0.5 mA at rated DC blocking voltage, IR2 maximum 50 mA at 100 degC, and typical CJ 160 pF.

The SS24F maximum repetitive peak reverse voltage and maximum DC blocking voltage are both 40 V; maximum average forward rectified current is 2.0 A and non-repetitive peak forward surge current is 50 A, all from p. 1 maximum ratings.
The reverse-current table also publishes IR2 = 50 mA at VR = VDC and TA = 100 degC; the extracted reverse_current input uses the 25 degC IR1 row.
No reverse recovery time or reverse-recovery test circuit is published, so reverse recovery is not modelled.
No breakdown-voltage or breakdown-current characteristic is published for this Schottky rectifier; the 40 V blocking rating is not used as a fitted breakdown pair.

Curve points were digitized from the supplied vector plots without interpolation between absent curves. Fig. 3 provides the SS22F-SS24F forward curve; Fig. 4 provides the SS22F-SS26F solid reverse curves at Tj = 25 degC and Tj = 100 degC.
